units.source_text: “配给？”大苍蝇拼命想飞起来，可实际上只是在窗玻璃上擦了下鼻尖……

en.t: “Rations?” The big fly struggled desperately to take off, but in fact it merely rubbed the tip of its nose against the windowpane...

units.source_text: 学名叫做Muscina stabulans……几乎没有视力，徒有其表的复眼……

en.t: Its scientific name was Muscina stabulans... it had almost no vision, only compound eyes that were impressive in appearance...

units.source_text: 他毫不掩饰狼狈，尖叫了一声，

en.t: He made no attempt to hide his distress and let out a shriek,
